name: Natsu no Oto
source:
The usual summer. Main character lives on a small island with two friends. It's a bit boring, but not unpleasant. The dream that should have lasted forever...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-may-2003-ashita-deatta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
平常的夏天。主角和两个朋友住在一个小岛上。这有点无聊，但并不令人不快。本来应该永远持续下去的梦想……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-may-2003-ashita-deatta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
